نصطبر (form VIII)
# نَصْطَبِرُ (naṣṭabiru) /nasˤ.tˤa.bi.ru/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِصْطَبَرَ (iṣṭabara)
# نَصْطَبِرَ (naṣṭabira) /nasˤ.tˤa.bi.ra/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِصْطَبَرَ (iṣṭabara)
# نَصْطَبِرْ (naṣṭabir) /nasˤ.tˤa.bir/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِصْطَبَرَ (iṣṭabara)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
